correctness.rationale: For balanced simple symmetric walk bridges S0=S2n=0 with n>=2, R=sum over interior even-time zeroes and Q=sum over t=1..2n-1 S_t². Exchangeable balanced signs give E S_t²=t(2n-t)/(2n-1) and EQ=n(2n+1)/3. Conditioning on any prescribed q≥1 interior zeroes decomposes into independent bridges, each length 2ell_j with energy ell_j(2ell_j+1)/3, yielding deficit (4/3) sum_{i<j}ell_i ell_j. One-contact probability c_k c_{n-k}/c_n, and [z^n](zB’(z))² for B=(1−4z)^(-1/2) yields Cov(R,Q)=−n(n−1)b_n/6, b_n=4^n/c_n. Three-segment renewal GF gives ER=b_n−2 and VarR=4n+2−b_n−b_n². Balanced signs m2=−1/(2n−1), m4=3/((2n−1)(2n−3)), and edge-weight equal/incident/disjoint sums give VarQ=8n²(n−1)(2n+1)/45. Stirling then gives limiting corr −sqrt(5pi)/(8sqrt(4−pi)). Independently enumerated all bridges n=2..7 and exact covariance; read original checker which enumerates to n=9, but bound not used as infinite proof.
